channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Mizoram to sign $108 million ADB loan deal to strengthen public healthcare
item.description: Health Minister Lalrinpuii said that 90% of the loan amount will be repaid by the Centre, while the state govt will repay 10% within 15 years

item.title: AIIMS Guwahati becomes Northeast’s first ATLS-accredited trauma centre
item.description: ATLS accreditation strengthens trauma response, emphasising timely treatment during the ‘golden hour’ to improve survival outcomes

item.title: Assam Congress takes fight to villages with outreach drive; CM casts doubt on move
item.description: APCC president Gaurav Gogoi said the drive aims to take the Congress leadership to every village across the state

item.title: 108 workers protest enters day 16, EMRI sets Dec 22 deadline to resume work
item.description: Protestors of All Assam 108 Mrityunjoy Employee Association’s protest demand job regularisation, EMRI Green Health Services warns of terminations after December 22.

item.title: Modi, Shah to visit Assam as BJP ramps up development & poll outreach
item.description: With the 2026 Assam Assembly polls in view, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah will visit Assam later this month as the state unveils major projects

item.title: Assam govt sets clear timelines for CM AAA benefits, ADRE appointments
item.description: Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma also announced timelines for health department recruitments aiming to complete the process before the election code kicks in.

item.title: AIUDF to contest over 17 seats in 2026 Assam polls, focus on Lumding
item.description: Sabir Ahmed, a tickect aspirant for the Lumding seat, has already started his public outreach campaign. He has been touring different areas including Udali, Nakhuti and Lumding,

item.title: ED raids 5 Manipur locations in Rs 50-cr investment scam linked to anti-India acts
item.description: Case traces back to a 2019 London press event where accused declared Manipur’s independence from India

item.title: Silchar residents rally behind flyover project, submit 15,000 signatures
item.description: Ex-MLA Dilip Kr Paul questions resistance to Silchar’s proposed flyover, asserting long-term urban development over temporary hurdles

item.title: Assam extends vehicle scrapping OTS till March 2026; relief on pending dues
item.description: With abandoned vehicles posing environmental threats, Assam Transport Department appeals for scrapping
